        for i in range(size):
            self._resources.put_nowait(f"conn-{i}")

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def acquire(self):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Pool is closed")
        await self._sem.acquire()
        resource = await self._resources.get()
        try:
            yield resource
        finally:
            if not self._closed:
                await self._resources.put(resource)
                self._sem.release()
            else:
                self._sem.release()

    async def close(self):
        self._closed = True

async def main():
    pool = AsyncPool(2)
    async def worker(name):
        async with pool.acquire() as conn:
            print(f"{name} using {conn}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    await asyncio.gather(*[worker(f"w-{i}") for i in range(5)])
    await pool.close()

asyncio.run(main())
